correctness.rationale: Uniform proof: the connected tight-graph criterion exhausts every polar extreme potential in 1<t<2. Direct centered coordinate calculation gives squared norm R_m(t)^2-[ta+(2-t)b]^2/(2m), and all balanced signs attain R_m(t). Opposite facets certify global inradius. Integer zero-defect profiles yield finite rational resonance set and exact binomial multiplicity; contact differences span W_A⊕W_B and resonance adds the missing block contrast, proving 1-to-0 dimension collapse. The finite center constraints supply strict nonzero slack away from resonance. For t approaching resonance, the primitive integer profile dominates the O((t-t0)^2) facet slack and yields the explicit quadratic coefficient. Python exact rational enumeration of 33120 classified potentials across 8 profiles, exact ranks, and 4 independent metric-halfspace reconstructions corroborate, but do not replace, the infinite proof.
